description: Displays an interactive signing field overlay positioned by normalized document coordinates.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a resize operation should start.

parameters.name: Completed
parameters.description: Whether the field is in an invalid state.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Whether the browser context menu is prevented for context menu interactions. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether the overlay should be rendered as read-only.

parameters.name: Draggable
parameters.description: Whether the overlay should be disabled.

parameters.name: Editable
parameters.description: Whether a pointer down on the overlay starts a move operation.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve localized field and option text.

parameters.name: Focused
parameters.description: Whether the field is currently selected.

parameters.name: Invalid
parameters.description: Whether the field currently has focus.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized text is missing.

parameters.name: OnContextMenu
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the overlay is double-clicked.

parameters.name: OnDoubleClick
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the overlay is clicked.

parameters.name: OnStartMove
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the overlay receives a context menu interaction.

parameters.name: OnStartResize
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a move operation should start.

parameters.name: PreventDefaultContextMenu
parameters.description: Whether resize handles should be shown.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the field has been completed.

parameters.name: Selected
parameters.description: Current field value. The expected value shape depends on the field type.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Normalized document area used to position the overlay.
